title: Toggleable Clouds
description: A mod which adds a hotkey that toggles clouds on and off.
body:
Toggleable Clouds adds a hotkey to simply toggle clouds on and off. For when the Clouds get in your way.  
The hotkey is configurable within the vanilla key binds settings.
